scripts.script:
-- Dynamic Headless, Korblox, Hair & Accessories Hub
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("HeadlessCustomGui") then
	PlayerGui.HeadlessCustomGui:Destroy()
end

local headlessActive = false
local korbloxActive = false
local hairActive = false
local expanded = false

-- Vytvoření GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "HeadlessCustomGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 195) -- Větší základní velikost pro Headless i Korblox
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.35, -95)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 32)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner") Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) Corner.Parent = MainFrame
local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke") Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 50, 65) Stroke.Thickness = 1.5 Stroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Nadpis
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 4)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "HEADLESS & KORBLOX HUB"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 11
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.Parent = MainFrame

-- Zavřít (X)
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 6)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50)
CloseBtn.Text = "?"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 11
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.Parent = MainFrame
local CC = Instance.new("UICorner") CC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) CC.Parent = CloseBtn

-- Tlačítko HEADLESS
local HeadlessBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
HeadlessBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
HeadlessBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 36)
HeadlessBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
HeadlessBtn.Text = "HEADLESS: OFF"
HeadlessBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HeadlessBtn.TextSize = 11
HeadlessBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
HeadlessBtn.Parent = MainFrame
local HC = Instance.new("UICorner") HC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) HC.Parent = HeadlessBtn

-- Tlačítko KORBLOX (Hned pod Headless)
local KorbloxBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
KorbloxBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
KorbloxBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 74)
KorbloxBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
KorbloxBtn.Text = "KORBLOX: OFF"
KorbloxBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
KorbloxBtn.TextSize = 11
KorbloxBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
KorbloxBtn.Parent = MainFrame
local KBC = Instance.new("UICorner") KBC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) KBC.Parent = KorbloxBtn

-- Tlačítko WITHOUT HAIR
local HairBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
HairBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
HairBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 112)
HairBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
HairBtn.Text = "WITHOUT HAIR: OFF"
HairBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HairBtn.TextSize = 11
HairBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
HairBtn.Parent = MainFrame
local HaC = Instance.new("UICorner") HaC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) HaC.Parent = HairBtn

-- Tlačítko pro rozbalení / zmenšení okna (Accessories)
local ExpandBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ExpandBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 32)
ExpandBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 150)
ExpandBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
ExpandBtn.Text = "MY ACCESSORIES ?"
ExpandBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ExpandBtn.TextSize = 11
ExpandBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ExpandBtn.Parent = MainFrame
local EC = Instance.new("UICorner") EC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) EC.Parent = ExpandBtn

-- Scrollovací seznam pro doplňky
local ScrollList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ScrollList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -195)
ScrollList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 190)
ScrollList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ScrollList.BorderSizePixel = 0
ScrollList.ScrollBarThickness = 4
ScrollList.Parent = MainFrame

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Parent = ScrollList

-----------------------------------------------------------
-- LOGIKA
-----------------------------------------------------------
local function setHeadless(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if head then
		head.Transparency = state and 1 or 0
		local face = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
		if face then face.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		head.CastShadow = not state
	end
end

local function setKorblox(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	-- Podpora pro R6 i R15
	local rightLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("Right ?")
	local rightFoot = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
	local upperLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")

	if state then
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightFoot then rightFoot.Transparency = 1 end
		-- Zmenšení / skrytí spodní části pro korblox efekt
		if char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot") then
			char.RightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		end
	else
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightFoot then 
			rightFoot.Transparency = 0 
			rightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		end
	end
end

local function setHair(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then handle.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		end
	end
end

local function refreshAccessories()
	for _, child in ipairs(ScrollList:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
	end

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end

	local count = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType ~= Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			count = count + 1
			local accName = item.Name
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")

			local itemFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
			itemFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 42)
			itemFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 36, 48)
			itemFrame.Parent = ScrollList
			local IFC = Instance.new("UICorner") IFC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6) IFC.Parent = itemFrame

			local imgLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			imgLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
			imgLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
			imgLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			imgLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://0"
			imgLabel.Parent = itemFrame
			local ILC = Instance.new("UICorner") ILC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) ILC.Parent = imgLabel

			task.spawn(function()
				if item:FindFirstChild("AssetId") then
					imgLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(item.AssetId)
				elseif handle and handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then
					local mesh = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
					if mesh.TextureId ~= "" then
						imgLabel.Image = mesh.TextureId
					end
				end
			end)

			local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, 0)
			nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 0)
			nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			nameLabel.Text = accName
			nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
			nameLabel.TextSize = 10
			nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			nameLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			nameLabel.Parent = itemFrame

			local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 30)
			toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -95, 0, 6)
			toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90)
			toggleBtn.Text = "VISIBLE"
			toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			toggleBtn.TextSize = 10
			toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			toggleBtn.Parent = itemFrame
			local TBC = Instance.new("UICorner") TBC.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5) TBC.Parent = toggleBtn

			local isHidden = false
			toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				isHidden = not isHidden
				if handle then handle.Transparency = isHidden and 1 or 0 end
				if isHidden then
					toggleBtn.Text = "HIDDEN"
					toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
				else
					toggleBtn.Text = "VISIBLE"
					toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	ScrollList.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 48)
end

-- Zvětšení / zmenšení okna
ExpandBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	expanded = not expanded
	if expanded then
		refreshAccessories()
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 450) -- Větší rozbalené okno
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.3, -225)
		ExpandBtn.Text = "MY ACCESSORIES ?"
	else
		MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 195) -- Základní velikost
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.35, -95)
		ExpandBtn.Text = "MY ACCESSORIES ?"
	end
end)

HeadlessBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	headlessActive = not headlessActive
	if headlessActive then
		HeadlessBtn.Text = "HEADLESS: ON"
		HeadlessBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
		setHeadless(true)
	else
		HeadlessBtn.Text = "HEADLESS: OFF"
		HeadlessBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
		setHeadless(false)
	end
end)

KorbloxBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	korbloxActive = not korbloxActive
	if korbloxActive then
		KorbloxBtn.Text = "KORBLOX: ON"
		KorbloxBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
		setKorblox(true)
	else
		KorbloxBtn.Text = "KORBLOX: OFF"
		KorbloxBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
		setKorblox(false)
	end
end)

HairBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	hairActive = not hairActive
	if hairActive then
		HairBtn.Text = "WITHOUT HAIR: ON"
		HairBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
		setHair(true)
	else
		HairBtn.Text = "WITHOUT HAIR: OFF"
		HairBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 52)
		setHair(false)
	end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.3)
	if headlessActive then setHeadless(true) end
	if korbloxActive then setKorblox(true) end
	if hairActive then setHair(true) end
	if expanded then refreshAccessories() end
end)

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	setHeadless(false)
	setKorblox(false)
	setHair(false)
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Přetahování okna
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true dragStart = input.Position startPos = MainFrame.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

scripts.title: Emote Speed Gui V2
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Função para restaurar a velocidade padrão (1) das animações tocando no momento
local function resetAnimSpeed()
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			if animator then
				for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					track:AdjustSpeed(1)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Se já existir uma versão anterior rodando, restaura a velocidade ao normal e remove a GUI
local guiAntiga = playerGui:FindFirstChild("AnimSpeedGUI")
if guiAntiga then
	resetAnimSpeed()
	guiAntiga:Destroy()
end

-- Tabela para guardar os IDs das animações de andar, correr, pular e idle
local locomotionIds = {}
local ultimaVelocidade = nil

-- Função para mapear as animações do sistema de movimentação do personagem
local function carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	locomotionIds = {}
	local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	if animateScript then
		local pastasMovimento = {"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "strafe"}
		for _, nomePasta in ipairs(pastasMovimento) do
			local pasta = animateScript:FindFirstChild(nomePasta)
			if pasta then
				for _, obj in ipairs(pasta:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
						locomotionIds[obj.AnimationId] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Conecta ao personagem para registrar IDs e monitorar novas animações
local function conectarCharacter(character)
	carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	if not animator then return end

	animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		task.wait(0.05)
		local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
		-- Aplica a velocidade salva caso uma nova animação de emote comece
		if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) and ultimaVelocidade then
			track:AdjustSpeed(ultimaVelocidade)
		end
	end)
end

if player.Character then
	conectarCharacter(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(conectarCharacter)

-- ScreenGui Principal
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AnimSpeedGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Frame Principal Minimalista
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "AnimSpeedFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 140)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 0)
mainFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local frameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
frameStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
frameStroke.Thickness = 1
frameStroke.Parent = mainFrame

-- Título
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "Title"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Velocidade do emote"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = mainFrame

-- Caixa de Entrada (TextBox)
local inputBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
inputBox.Name = "InputBox"
inputBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 35)
inputBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.28, 0)
inputBox.PlaceholderText = "Digite a velocidade..."
inputBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
inputBox.Text = ""
inputBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
inputBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
inputBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
inputBox.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
inputBox.TextSize = 15
inputBox.Parent = mainFrame

local inputCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
inputCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
inputCorner.Parent = inputBox

-- Permite APENAS números no campo de texto
inputBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local textoFiltrado = inputBox.Text:gsub("[^%d.]", "")
	if inputBox.Text ~= textoFiltrado then
		inputBox.Text = textoFiltrado
	end
end)

-- Botão Submit (Aplicar)
local submitButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
submitButton.Name = "SubmitButton"
submitButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 35)
submitButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.62, 0)
submitButton.Text = "Aplicar"
submitButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
submitButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
submitButton.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
submitButton.TextSize = 16
submitButton.AutoButtonColor = true
submitButton.Parent = mainFrame

local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
buttonCorner.Parent = submitButton

-- Função para alterar a velocidade dos emotes tocando no momento
local function setAnimSpeed(speed)
	if not speed then return end
	ultimaVelocidade = speed

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			if animator then
				for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
					-- Altera a velocidade APENAS se não for uma animação do Animate script (idle/walk/run/jump)
					if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) then
						track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Função disparada para aplicar a alteração
local function aplicarMudanca()
	local speed = tonumber(inputBox.Text)
	if speed then
		setAnimSpeed(speed)
	end
end

-- Clique no botão de Aplicar
submitButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(aplicarMudanca)
scripts.features:
📋 Visão Geral do Script
Este script cria uma interface gráfica (GUI) minimalista no Roblox que permite ao jogador controlar e alterar dinamicamente a velocidade de reprodução dos seus emotes e animações de ações, sem afetar os movimentos básicos do personagem (como andar, correr ou pular).
✨ Principais Características
1. 🔄 Sistema de Reinicialização Automática (Reset)
Prevenção de sobreposição: Toda vez que o script é executado novamente, ele localiza qualquer versão antiga da interface e a remove.
Restauração de velocidade: Antes de deletar a versão anterior, o script chama a função resetAnimSpeed(), que redefine a velocidade de todas as animações tocando no momento de volta ao padrão do jogo (1.0x), garantindo que o personagem não fique "preso" em velocidades alteradas.
2. 🚶 Proteção do Sistema de Movimentação (Locomotion Filter)
Filtro inteligente: O script varre o script interno Animate do personagem e mapeia os IDs de animação padrão:
idle (parado)
walk (andando)
run (correndo)
jump / fall (pulando / caindo)
climb / swim / strafe (escalando / nadando / esquivando)
Preservação de física: A velocidade modificada é aplicada apenas em emotes/danças, garantindo que as animações de passos e pulos do personagem continuem naturais e sincronizadas com o movimento.
3. 🎯 Aplicação Automática em Novos Emotes
Escuta contínua (AnimationPlayed): Monitora quando uma nova animação começa a tocar no personagem.
Ajuste dinâmico: Se você trocar de emote enquanto uma velocidade personalizada estiver definida, a nova dança adotará automaticamente essa mesma velocidade sem que você precise clicar em "Aplicar" novamente.
4. 🎨 Interface Gráfica (GUI) Modernizada
Visual Dark/Minimalista: Frame escuro (RGB 28, 28, 28) com cantos arredondados (UICorner) e bordas suaves (UIStroke).
Campo de texto inteligente: Aceita apenas números e ponto decimal, filtrando letras e caracteres especiais automaticamente para evitar erros de digitação.
Manutenção em Respawn (ResetOnSpawn = false): A interface não desaparece quando seu personagem morre ou renasce no jogo.

scripts.features:
Stand cmds

-- how to multi-target?
-- example: .k user1 user2
--          .lk user1 user2
--          .watchlk user1 user2

.s -- summon the stand
.v -- hide / void the stand

.left -- stand position left
.right -- stand position right
.change char -- saitama, bald, genos, garou, hunter, batter, blade, esper, ninja, purple, tech, zombie

.k @user -- kill once (single or multiple)
.lk @user -- loop kill (single or multiple)
.kstando @user -- detects a stand user and uses a different attack method
.lkstando @user -- same but loopkill
.watchlk @user -- loop kill + track leave/rejoin
.watchlk off

.kb @user -- stay behind target, then send 1-4
.kb off

.f @user -- fling target
.bring @user -- hunter skill 
.b @user -- same as .bring
.throw @user -- throw trash can (owner can use .throw me)
.void @user -- hunter void (skill 1 or 2)
.hv @user -- same as .void
.ult -- activate ult

.op -- owner protect toggle
.sp -- stand protect toggle
.m1block -- M1 when owner blocks
.exploiter -- unpredictable vs other exploits
.exploiter off
.formation -- sync stands
.inv -- invisible mode
.inv off
.toxic -- taunt after kills
.toxic off

.enable -- chat 1-4: stand comes in front and uses skill
.disable
1 -- use skill 1 (after .enable or during .kb)
2 -- use skill 2
3 -- use skill 3
4 -- use skill 4 (hunter skips 4)

.tp me place
.tp @user place

places:
safe, mountain1, mountain2, jail, death, middle, corner

.br @user -- bring target to you

.owner @user -- temporary owner
.backup -- restore original owner
.rejoin -- rejoin server
.cmds -- show commands

.unfreeze -- unfreeze stand

-- Premium
.freeze -- freeze stand
.betray @user -- steal stand
.kick @user -- kick other free stands
.ban @user -- ban other free stands
(You can use it on specific free users or on all free users in the server)
